verdict.rationale: Crossplane operates as a continuously-reconciling Kubernetes control plane rather than a plan/apply tool with saved plan artifacts and approval gates; the evidence pack contains no documentation of a CI-oriented plan/apply/approve workflow. The hands-on probe explicitly notes that unlike Terraform-style tools, 'every real plan/apply operation requires a running Kubernetes cluster... no local plan/preview loop exists,' confirming the absence of this capability.
